meta.source: inputs/reference.mp4 (a 30 s deadpan comedy two-hander for an AI assistant; a 2026 award winner)
meta.transitions: hard cuts only; no dissolves, no black frames

acts.name: The ask
acts.function: A skinny teen fails a pull-up, drops and asks a big trainer for a quick six-pack. The request is innocent and a little needy.

acts.name: The friendly answer
acts.function: A 2.38 s deadpan beat, then an assistant-style affirmation ('Perfect. That is a clear and achievable goal.') that turns on 'But confidence isn't just built in the gym' over the teen's silent close.

acts.name: The slide into the ad
acts.function: The answer becomes an ad read in the same warm voice: product name, an absurd claim aimed at the teen's insecurity, promo code and discount; intercut with the teen's silent closes.

acts.name: The point
acts.function: Music hits on the trainer's frozen salesman grin with super 1; super 2 over the teen staring flatly with his phone.

acts.name: End card
acts.function: Brand wordmark and tagline on a warm field, sung hook over it.

sound.speech: Two voices, all on-location dialogue (no voice-over): the teen's one line (L01) on camera; the trainer's seven lines (L02-L08), on camera in shots 3, 5, 7 and heard off-screen over the teen's closes in shots 4 and 6, where lines carry across cuts. Delivery: the teen earnest and breathy; the trainer warm, measured, upbeat, a customer-service read that never changes tone as it turns into an ad.
sound.timing: The comedy is timing: hold the 2.38 s silence after the question (5.67-8.05) on the trainer; keep every pause between his phrases (see set/lines.json); the reaction closes are silent holds; the music lands exactly when the code line ends (22.97) and the grin freezes.
sound.mix: Dialogue up front at about -27 LUFS short-term, room tone under it, no music until 22.97; the music then sits at about -26 LUFS with nothing over it.
sound.files: set/score.wav = the soundtrack with the dialogue replaced by room tone (the grunt, ambience and music kept); set/lines/L01-L08 = the dialogue; set/dialogue_30.wav and set/dialogue_15.wav = the lines alone on each cut's timeline (guide audio for speaking shots).

cut30.arc: Hook (0-5.67): a skinny teen fails a pull-up, drops and asks the trainer 'Hey, can I get a six-pack quickly?'. Middle (5.67-22.93): the trainer's 2.38 s deadpan beat, then a friendly assistant-style answer ('Perfect. That is a clear and achievable goal.') that slides phrase by phrase into an ad read ('But confidence isn't just built in the gym. Try {PITCH_PRODUCT}. The insoles that add one vertical inch of height and help short kings stand tall. Use code {PROMO_CODE} for big discounts.'), intercut with the teen's silent closes. Payoff (22.93-28.23): the music hits on the trainer's frozen salesman grin under super 1; super 2 on the teen staring flatly with his phone. End card (28.23-30.00).
